newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak crown, money market rates seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Slovak crown, money market rates seen stable.

text.p: 0800 GMT - Slovak crown moves within a tight range in early Friday trading, with dealers saying they do not expect much deviation in the trend throughout the day.
*Crown hovers at around -0.10 to -0.15 percent on the depreciation side of its mark/dollar basket parity, with sporadic jumps to -0.20 percent versus the basket midpoint.
*"We don't expect very interesting trading today, only obvious fluctuations. The activity has been dampened also by (the U.S. national holiday)," said one dealer.
*NBS Thursday fixing, crown/dollar 33.719, crown/mark 19.210, deviation against the midpoint -0.20 percent.
*"The sector will probably remain slightly short of liquidity through the weekend," one dealer said.
"I think tom/next rates will keep their present level, with one-week prices at around 20 percent," he added.
